title: Affine derived base-change comparison map and its localization
statement: Let R\to A and R\to R' be ring maps and put A'=A\otimes_R R'. For a complex M^\bullet of A-modules [def-pc-derived-category] there is a canonical comparison morphism c:M^\bullet\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R'\to M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A' in D(R') (Stacks, More on Algebra, equation comparison-map): it is E^\bullet\otimes_R R'\to P^\bullet\otimes_A A' for a K-flat complex P^\bullet of A-modules representing M^\bullet and a quasi-isomorphism E^\bullet\to P^\bullet from a K-flat complex E^\bullet of R-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex]. For every i, H^i(M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A') has its evident A'-module structure, while H^i(M^\bullet\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R') is an A'-module as follows: a in A acts by H^i(a\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}\operatorname{id}_{R'}) through End_{D(A)}(M^\bullet)\to End_{D(R)}(M^\bullet)\to End_{D(R')}(M^\bullet\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R'), and this action commutes with R', hence combines to an A'=A\otimes_R R' action. With these structures H^i(c) is A'-linear. For every prime \mathfrak q' of A', with images \mathfrak q of A and \mathfrak p',\mathfrak p of R',R, there are natural isomorphisms H^i(M^\bullet\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R')\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'}\cong H^i(M^\bullet_{\mathfrak q}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_{\mathfrak p}}R'_{\mathfrak p'})\otimes_{A_{\mathfrak q}\otimes_{R_{\mathfrak p}}R'_{\mathfrak p'}}A'_{\mathfrak q'} and H^i(M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A')\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'}\cong H^i(M^\bullet_{\mathfrak q}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_{\mathfrak q}}A'_{\mathfrak q'}), under which H^i(c)\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'} is the map induced by the comparison morphism for R_{\mathfrak p}\to A_{\mathfrak q}, R_{\mathfrak p}\to R'_{\mathfrak p'} followed by scalar extension along A_{\mathfrak q}\otimes_{R_{\mathfrak p}}R'_{\mathfrak p'}\to A'_{\mathfrak q'}.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, affine proof, displayed localization identity before the equivalence of conditions

proof.text: Choose a K-flat A-complex P^\bullet representing M^\bullet and a K-flat R-complex E^\bullet with a quasi-isomorphism E^\bullet\to P^\bullet, using [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] after restricting scalars. The derived tensors are represented by the displayed K-flat models by the K-flat definition. By [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] (on the one-point site, for R\to R' and for A\to A'), a quasi-isomorphism of K-flat complexes stays one after scalar extension and the derived change of rings is a functor computed by any K-flat resolution with canonical comparison isomorphisms; applied to E^\bullet\to P^\bullet (restricted to R) this shows that E^\bullet\otimes_R R'\to P^\bullet\otimes_R R'\to P^\bullet\otimes_A A' defines a morphism c in D(R') independent of the choices of E^\bullet and P^\bullet, and, choosing resolutions compatibly with a morphism M^\bullet\to N^\bullet in D(A), natural in M^\bullet.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, affine proof, construction and independence of K-flat models

proof.text: The target complex P^\bullet\otimes_A A' is a complex of A'-modules. On the source cohomology, define the A-action by applying H^i to the endomorphism a\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}\operatorname{id}_{R'} induced by a in End_{D(A)}(M^\bullet), then compose restriction of scalars to D(R) and derived tensor with R'. The resulting A-action commutes with the scalar R'-action, so it extends to A'. Naturality of c in M^\bullet (Step 1), applied to the endomorphisms a of M^\bullet, makes H^i(c) A'-linear.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, affine proof, A'-linearity of the comparison map

proof.text: For a prime \mathfrak q' of A' with images \mathfrak q, \mathfrak p' and \mathfrak p, the source isomorphism H^i(M^\bullet\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R')\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'}\cong H^i(M^\bullet_{\mathfrak q}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_{\mathfrak p}}R'_{\mathfrak p'})\otimes_{A_{\mathfrak q}\otimes_{R_{\mathfrak p}}R'_{\mathfrak p'}}A'_{\mathfrak q'}, for the A'-action of Step 2, and its compatibility with c are [lem-pc-derived-tensor-localization-cohomology]; no A'-localization of the R-complex E^\bullet\otimes_R R' is used. For the target, only the A-complex P^\bullet is localized: P^\bullet_{\mathfrak q} is K-flat over A_{\mathfrak q} (for an acyclic A_{\mathfrak q}-complex F^\bullet, F^\bullet\otimes_{A_{\mathfrak q}}P^\bullet_{\mathfrak q}=F^\bullet\otimes_A P^\bullet) and represents M^\bullet_{\mathfrak q}, and the localization-of-tensor-products identification [lem-weil-pbc-localization-tensor-product] gives (P^\bullet\otimes_A A')\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'}\cong P^\bullet_{\mathfrak q}\otimes_{A_{\mathfrak q}}A'_{\mathfrak q'}, a model of M^\bullet_{\mathfrak q}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_{\mathfrak q}}A'_{\mathfrak q'}.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, affine proof, displayed localization identities

proof.text: For the A'-complexes P^\bullet\otimes_A A' and their localizations, localization is exact [lem-weil-pbc-localization-module-exact], so kernels and images of differentials localize and H^i(C)\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'}\cong H^i(C\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'}). Applying this to the target complex and using Step 3 gives the two stated cohomology isomorphisms. Naturality of the tensor maps gives that H^i(c)\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'} is induced by the localized comparison followed by the stated scalar extension.
